aliases: Omni 6C Series 4 MP 40X DarkFighter Network Speed Dome

resolution.label: 4 MP 40X PTZ + multi-sensor panoramic (up to 8 MP)

sensor: [Panoramic] 1/1.8" (4 MP variant) or 1/1.2" (8 MP variant) Progressive Scan CMOS, [PTZ] 1/1.8" Progressive Scan CMOS

lens.aperture: [Panoramic] F1.4 (4 MP variant) or F1.6 (8 MP variant); [PTZ] F1.2

field_of_view_deg: [Panoramic] 39.6-8.9 horizontal (4 MP variant) / 36.4-13.1 horizontal (8 MP variant); [PTZ] 59.1-2 horizontal
features: Omni multi-sensor: dual panoramic bullet channels + 40X optical zoom PTZ
IR up to 200m (PTZ) / 80m (panoramic); white light up to 30m (PTZ) / 15m (panoramic)
panoramic pan 0-190 / tilt 5-20; PTZ pan 0-360 / tilt -10 to 180
IP67 water/dust resistant, IK10 vandal resistant (excluding glass window)
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2SK6C440MXG1 is an Omni 6C Series multi-sensor speed dome pairing dual panoramic bullet channels (4 MP on the /28 variant, 8 MP on the /216 variant) with a 4 MP 40X DarkFighter 2.0 PTZ channel, IR to 200m, IP67/IK10. Specs verified against the official Hikvision datasheet DS-2SK6C440MXG1_LM-L_28C5C5_Datasheet_20260827.
